$schema: gate-mode pins (E2E-9, e2e ADR-0001 'Candidate artifacts, not HEAD')
comment: Exact 40-hex commit SHAs that gate-mode runs build. Nothing floating: a value that is not a full SHA fails the run. The Release Conductor (E2E-8, #12) will regenerate this file from each Release Manifest; until then it is updated by hand as sibling mains move. Dev Mode ignores this file — testing main HEADs is its job.
